optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Data Quality Engineer, Logistics Delivery Services
professionalSummary: Owned the scan‑event data quality programme for the delivery division for two and a half years, deciding which quality rules were enforced at ingestion and managing rule modes.
Built and maintained a Python‑based quality‑rule engine and dashboards that track rule breaches per depot and driver app version.
Led the weekly data quality review with depot operations, recording decisions and escalations.
Coordinated rule changes with settlement and platform teams, clearly defining ownership boundaries.
experienceHighlights: Programme ownership and rule decision authority for scan‑event data quality.
Development and maintenance of the quality‑rule engine and dashboards.
Leadership of weekly data quality reviews and documentation of outcomes.
Cross‑team coordination of rule changes and ownership delineation.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Data governance register entry naming the candidate as programme owner.
Rule change log showing mode switches under the candidate’s user ID.
Weekly review log with decisions and escalation records.
Pipeline rule‑release identifiers as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s ownership of the scan‑event data quality programme, development of the rule engine and dashboards, leadership of weekly reviews, and coordination with settlement and platform teams. They do not provide evidence of any other roles or responsibilities beyond those described.

role.roleTitle: Data Quality Engineer, Logistics Delivery Services

evidence.text: Owned the scan-event data quality programme for the delivery division for two and a half years, deciding which quality rules were enforced at ingestion as the programme's named owner in the data governance register, and switching rules between warn and block modes under my own authority.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of ownership and rule decision authority.

evidence.text: Reference call with the former head of data: confirmed the candidate was the registered programme owner, decided rule enforcement and led the weekly review; confirmed employment dates.
Built and maintained the quality-rule engine (Python rules evaluated in the ingestion pipeline) and the quality dashboards showing rule breaches per depot and driver app version.
evidence.notes: Direct description of engine and dashboard development.

evidence.text: Work sample: the data governance register entry naming the candidate as programme owner, the rule change log showing mode switches under the candidate's user id and one weekly review log, with the pipeline's rule-release identifiers as a verification trail.
evidence.notes: Sample evidence of engine and dashboard artifacts.

evidence.text: Led the weekly data quality review with depot operations, deciding which breaches were escalated to depot managers and recording the decisions in the review log.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of review leadership and documentation.

evidence.text: Work sample: ... one weekly review log, with the pipeline's rule-release identifiers as a verification trail.

Coordinated rule changes with the settlement and platform teams through the data change process, recording that the settlement team owned the settlement calculation and the platform team owned the ingestion pipeline while I owned the rules.
Responsibilities included programme ownership, rule decisions, rule-engine development, dashboards and the weekly quality review for scan-event data over about two and a half years.
evidence.notes: Implied documentation of rule definitions and hand‑over conditions.
